targets.description: Image targets to build (e.g., beaglebone, raspberry3, amd64, etc.)

hostname.description: Hostname to set inside the built images

distribution.description: Debian release to use in built image

image_size.description: Size of the image to build (e.g., '4G', '8G')

build_mirror.description: Debian mirror to use for building

mirror.description: Debian mirror to use in built image

build_dir.description: Directory to build images and create log file

build_stamp.description: Build stamp to use on image file names (e.g., YYYYMMDD)

sign.description: Sign the images with default GPG key after building

force.description: Force rebuild of images even when required image exists

build_in_ram.description: Build the image in RAM for faster build (requires RAM equal to image size)

packages.description: Additional packages to install in the image

custom_packages.description: Path(s) to DEB file(s) to install into the image

enable_backports.description: Enable backports in the image (default: true; backports are enabled for stable by default)

with_build_dep.description: Include build dependencies in the image
